entries.finding: paper says 117 external images are integrated with all project-provided images for training, then evaluates all 10 project images; no untouched project split is visible
DeepLabV3+ reports mIoU=0.8435, Precision=0.9356, Recall=0.8779; arithmetic values are recorded but generalization evidence is downgraded by split provenance
22 reported fractures use P=94.25 mm, consistent with pi*30 mm
keypoint sampling has best R2=0.9177 and RMSE=1.6277 but 10 ±5% outliers, worse than equal=8 and adaptive=9
paper states only one pair exceeds >0.5, yet later reports a large connected component spanning holes 3,6,2,5; one undirected edge cannot connect four holes
weighted geometry/JRC similarity is bounded but no calibration against connectivity labels is shown
Bayesian/EIG terminology appears, but visible method does not specify likelihood, posterior update, or expectation over future observations
notebooks/scripts are referenced but not included as author source in the PDF-only collection

global_gates: prediction metrics cannot outrun split provenance
multi-metric winner requires primary utility/Pareto rule
network conclusions must replay from thresholded edge registry
compatibility score is not calibrated probability
EIG requires observation and posterior update model
